observed.request: 60-second AI Infinity launch video in Pashto, 9:16, format=short
observed.failure: cinematic launch motion coverage failed: 4 source-motion scene(s), 5 required; still-image animation is not a substitute
provider_blockers: Openverse timed out on the failing scene

baseline.root_cause: The curated source-video selector used ordinal scene-index mapping. For a five-scene short, the closing focus was a finished video on a studio display, but source index 5 depicts a woman recording on a smartphone and requires creator+camera concepts. The production relevance gate correctly rejected it, and professional truth correctly kept the render unverified.

changes.implementation: Scene-aware curated motion selection now ranks the existing allow-listed source clips against actual focus concepts and source title/description/tags, prefers relevant HD assets on constrained FAST workers, excludes scene-duplicate source bytes and retries the next relevant clip after download or probe failure. The finished_video concept recognises 'finished edited video'.
regression_tests: wrong ordinal source is not selected for the final-screen shot
a timed-out matching clip retries another compatible clip
the creator-filming clip remains selected for a creator/camera scene
changes.invariant: No quality gate, source-rights gate, distinct-source requirement or verification threshold is weakened.
